description.en: WeChat ClawBot bridge for DeepSeek Harness: a QR-login floating ball relays messages to agent sessions and reuses context tokens for out-of-window proactive push (maintained fork of lubaiUwU/DSH-WeChatClawBot).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的微信 ClawBot 桥接：扫码登录悬浮球把消息桥接到 agent 会话，并复用 context_token 支持窗口外主动推送（lubaiUwU/DSH-WeChatClawBot 的维护分支）。
